question: True statement regarding insulin:

options.opa: Produced by alpha cells of pancreas
options.opb: Two polypeptide chains are bound by disulfide linkages

analysis: Insulin is produced by beta cells of the pancreas, not alpha cells. It consists of two polypeptide chains that are bound by disulfide linkages. Insulin does not shift potassium outside the cell, but rather promotes the uptake of potassium into cells. The subcutaneous insulin half-life is approximately 60-90 minutes.
